preservedGuards: living local ownership and exact selection before Move
actual first assigned order and engine0.7 arrival

clearance.search: Finite visible tile centers within1..12world units; shortest clear straight sampled route; destination9unit trial corridor checked plus eight .700001 arrival-offset samples
clearance.dispatch: ONE ordinary Move; record actual assigned target and arrival<=.700001; require living ownership; revalidate corridor at actual arrival before trial
clearance.retry: No automatic alternative/retry if arrival or corridor fails
